metadata.notes: DeepSeek Harness 0.1.5-rc.2 has no first-party cloud background-agent dispatch surface; its Web and automation profiles run in a local dsh process.

assessment.body:
## Verdict

agent_supports: no
daemon_capability: n/a
driver_capability: ready

## Reasoning

The scenario requires a user to dispatch a coding-agent run to remote infrastructure. The run must continue without a local agent process. DeepSeek Harness 0.1.5-rc.2 does not ship that product surface. The official launcher exposes profile boot, Web, headless, SDK, SDK-minimal, ACP, and plugin-management modes. Each mode boots a local Node process. The official root README says `dsh web` starts a server at `http://127.0.0.1:3080`; an SSH launch prints the host URL for port forwarding. This is a self-hosted local process on the execution host, not a first-party cloud task service.

The required binary scan confirms the same boundary. `strings $(which dsh) | grep -iE 'cloud|remote|background|webhook|sidecar|hosted|server|web'` found only the local `web` profile alias. It found no cloud, remote, background-agent, hosted-run, webhook, or sidecar launch surface. A source scan of upstream commit `ddefc45fbc7f8e46dd73185e68295696d1297887` found zero occurrences of `cloud agent`, `cloud session`, `cloud run`, `hosted agent`, or `hosted session`. The `background agent` occurrences describe in-process child subagents. The `remote session` occurrences describe ACP protocol children that the harness starts through its subprocess seam. Neither is a top-level task dispatched to vendor-hosted infrastructure.

Because DeepSeek Harness cannot perform the scenario, daemon capability is not applicable. For completeness, the current irrlicht adapter could not observe such a future remote run. `core/adapters/inbound/agents/dsh/agent.go` declares `FilesUnderRoot` for `$DSH_HOME/sessions`, and it binds sessions to a local process through the writer of `session.lock`. A run with no local transcript and no local process would leave no input for this adapter.

The driver is ready by the frozen-no-feature convention. The interactive driver implements every current primitive, but no recipe can elicit a cloud run that the agent does not provide. The recipe is therefore `applicable:false`.

## What would change the verdict

DeepSeek would need to ship a hosted task service or a remote-run command that dispatches a session to provider-managed infrastructure. A later irrlicht change would then need a remote API, webhook, or stream source to observe the PID-less lifecycle.
caveats: Vacuous-pass condition: a no-phase spec would pass without any remote run. This cell is frozen, and its meta-only spec makes no behavioral pass claim.

The Web profile can listen beyond loopback when a user deliberately exposes a self-hosted server. The dsh process still runs on that host and owns the session, so this is not the provider-hosted PID-less task required by the scenario.
DeepSeek Harness is a developer preview and changes rapidly. Re-run the launcher, binary, and upstream source scans before changing this verdict in a later release.
If DeepSeek Harness later ships a hosted run, the current FilesUnderRoot plus session.lock adapter would become daemon=incapable until irrlicht adds a remote-feed source.

sources.note: Installed 0.1.5-rc.2 launcher; strings scan for cloud, remote, background, webhook, sidecar, hosted, server, and web found only the local Web-profile alias and no remote-run surface.
Installed official CLI reference lists the complete entry modes: local profile boot, Web, headless, SDK, SDK-minimal, ACP, and plugin management.
Official README: dsh web starts at 127.0.0.1:3080 and an SSH launch uses the host URL; this documents a self-hosted process, not a managed cloud task service.
Official launcher source reference enumerates every supported entry mode; none dispatches a task to remote infrastructure.

Upstream source scan found no cloud-agent, cloud-session, cloud-run, hosted-agent, or hosted-session surface; background-agent matches are child-subagent controls, and remote-session matches are subprocess-backed ACP children.
The irrlicht adapter reads local transcript files under $DSH_HOME/sessions and discovers a local PID from session.lock; it has no remote-feed source.
The adapter accepts local session.vN.jsonl.zstd paths under session-UUID directories and defines the local dsh process matcher.
The cloud_agent trait means dispatching a run to remote infrastructure with no local PID; local Web hosting and in-process subagents do not meet it.

recipe.notes: agent_supports=no: DeepSeek Harness 0.1.5-rc.2 has no first-party cloud or remote background-run dispatch surface. No executable recipe exists; the cell is frozen.
